aarti.tek: Victory to you, Lakṣmī and Viṣṇu; victory to you, Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa; victory to you, Lakṣmī and Viṣṇu. Victory to you, Mādhava; victory to you, lord of Śrī. Victory, victory, victory to you, Viṣṇu.
aarti.pad1: Victory to you, Lakṣmī, coloured like the champak flower; victory to you, Viṣṇu, whose lustre is that of a rain cloud. Victory to you, Lakṣmī, graced by a gentle smile; victory to you, Viṣṇu, of wondrous peace. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: Lakṣmī, holding a lotus, your hands granting boons and freedom from fear; Viṣṇu, bearer of the conch and the rest: victory to you, Lakṣmī, who dwell in the lotus, and Viṣṇu, who ride Garuḍa as your seat. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: Lakṣmī, whose hands and feet are of being and consciousness; Viṣṇu, whose form is being and consciousness; Lakṣmī, who delight in divine bliss: victory to you, Viṣṇu, whose form is bliss. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: You are the mother of the three worlds; you are the protector of all. You are the mother who gave birth to the three worlds; you are the upholder of all. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: You are the giver of wealth, kin, happiness, children and victory; and you, who wear the garland of forest flowers, are the giver of supreme bliss. ॥5॥
aarti.pad6: You dwell in homes where there is good sense; you are the master of all, the indweller of the sentient and the insentient. ॥6॥
aarti.pad7: I have come to you for refuge; have mercy on me, Mother. Victory to you, Lakṣmī-Nārāyaṇa, giver of ever-new blessings. ॥7॥
